description: Filter a survey table of external MOF databases (CoRE MOF, QMOF, hMOF, CSD and others): identifier scheme, source method, data type, size, coverage flags (negative data, topology, LCD/PLD, ASA/VF/density, stability, synthesis/activation, API), formats, license and link with a link_status. Free; it does not count as a tool call and launches nothing. Use it to decide which database could supply structures, labels or negative data for a task and how to cross-link them (MOFid, Refcode). The table is unverified metadata, not evidence: it contains no structures or property values, its sizes and flags were not checked, and only link_status 'doi' or 'website' rows have a usable locator. Pass null for any filter you do not need; all given filters must hold.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the database name, or null.

method.description: Keep databases whose source methods include this normalized method, or null.

data_type_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the data type column (for example 'Ads', 'Synth', 'Stability'), or null.

identifier.description: Keep databases that index entries by this identifier scheme, or null.

required_fields.description: Coverage flags that must all be Y, or null.

usable_link_only.description: true keeps only rows whose link is a complete DOI or a website; null or false keeps all.
